title: Reset a user's one-time password in Keycloak
about: Filmed on Keycloak 26.8.2 on 19 November 2026, in the guide's first order: delete, then require a new authenticator. The written guide now adds the required action first, which a test on 28 November showed is safer.
where: Recorded on Keycloak 26.8.2, open-source software, with a test realm and test users
